constraints.statement: Physical raw/pending/receipt keys are the plan prefixes plus a canonical lowercase0x64-hex transaction; metadata is the exact capacity key. No other physical key is read/written/listed. Raw value is exactly original JSON text as a string, immutable after first accepted write. Pending value is {transaction:canonicalTransaction}. Terminal receipt is a bounded JSON-compatible object. Metadata is {version:1,identity,recordCount,chargedBytes,cursor}; identity is the immutable normalized tuple {network,asset,payTo,operation,method,route,amount,sku,gateway,ledgerAccount} from the admitted plan. Before POST or receiving effects, require stored identity exactly match the normalized current tuple; a mismatch holds without mutation or provider calls, never permanently refuses an accepted pending item because its configured price/SKU/other identity changed. Migration/version receiving is a separate owner operation, not implicit reinitialization. cursor is null or one canonical pending physical key, not caller supplied. Count all physical records including metadata. Charge each nonmetadata record UTF8(key)+UTF8(JSON.stringify(storedValue)); reserve exactly4096 charged bytes for metadata and require its key+serializedvalue fits4096. chargedBytes equals that reserve plus accepted record charges; update counters atomically with every changed record. Validate stored metadata types/ranges/cursor before use; missing metadata may initialize only if a bounded prefix LIST(limit1) proves no existing owned records. Corrupt metadata/owned records fail closed; never reset counters over existing custody.

Cancel/finish response bodies; no second provider request, fallback, arbitrary fetch, parse/reissue packet or mutation outside fixed provider. Existing journal owns duplicate identity comparison and post-settlement failure reporting; a failed custody attempt cannot undo an already settled transfer and must never be reported as received custody.

Trusted adapters provide original witnessProblem,corroborate,usdc, original BASE_PROVIDERS exactly [https://base-rpc.publicnode.com,https://base.drpc.org,https://base-mainnet.public.blastapi.io,https://mainnet.base.org], fetch (defaultglobalThis.fetch), now(defaultDate.now) and groupPayers a Set of lowercase EVM addresses. No reimplementation of transfer matching or receipt agreement. Validate adapters/config/time before any network. A pulse considers at most4 DISTINCT pending witnesses. For each original raw witness call original witnessProblem; permanent invalid testimony becomes a terminal refusal. Otherwise at most4 sequential RPC attempts in the original provider order, stop after2 nonnull receipt results, POST eth_getTransactionReceipt with original transaction, no automatic retry or redirected fetch. Each response uses manual redirect/status200,10-second complete-body timeout, actual byte ceiling262144, fatal UTF8 and JSON parse; network/non200/malformed/timeout becomes a missing provider observation without disclosing body. Missing/disagreement with checked.retry true remains pending for the NEXT regular pulse; no immediate pulse retry. checked.ok false without retry is a terminal refusal and pending is removed only atomically with terminal record. Source/clock/corrupt-state failures hold prior custody. A configuration identity mismatch returns exactly {status:'held',reason:'configuration-identity-changed'} without network/mutations. Otherwise return exactly {status:'observed',considered,providerRequests,corroborated,refused,retryPending}; counters concern only selected distinct witnesses in this pulse, and corroborated/refused increment only after their terminal transaction commits. No global pending count or whole-store scan.

The inherited usd field is only the legacy USDC-unit conversion, not independently received USD value; currency is USDC and usdValuation stays null. Do not count a USD daily goal from this field. Unknown payer is never outside-confirmed or revenue; cash observation, delivery preparation and buyer acceptance remain separate. Store the successful cash record directly at its receipt key. Permanent refusal is exactly {status:'refused',transaction,witnessKey,reason:checked.reason,at:canonicalObservedInstant}, with no cash/sourceId invention. A metadata-only cursor advance may allow later witnesses after a refused terminal write, preserving quota and original/pending testimony.
